messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: high 5xx rate (7.2%) for inference-gateway-usw2 across /v1/generate (2m window). Alert: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
PagerDuty: auto-assigned to Alice (OnCall) — please acknowledge or escalate.
Alice (OnCall): acked — looking. Pulling up dashboards and logs now.
Alice (OnCall): grafana: spike correlates with 14:22 -> 14:26 UTC, route=/v1/generate, p50 latency up 300ms.
Bob (SRE): Any recent deploys to inference-gateway-usw2 in the last 30m?
Erin (Infra): Not from infra. I see repeated kv-proxy OOM events on the sidecar (evictions around 14:20).
Alice (OnCall): logs show kvcache evict + upstream 502s. Snippet:```text
2026-03-17T14:21:03Z kvcache: evict key=ctx_0 size=12MB
2026-03-17T14:21:04Z gateway: upstream error 502 backend=kv-proxy-2
2026-03-17T14:21:05Z gateway: request id=cli_9a8b status=502 route=/v1/generate
```
Bob (SRE): If kv-proxy is OOMing that would explain fanout 502s. Can you check node memory and OOM count?
Erin (Infra): Node mem usage: node-usc-12 at 92%, multiple pods hitting RSS limit. We're increasing kvcache memory limit to 2Gi and will restart the kv-proxy DaemonSet one shard at a time.
Carla (Product): Any customer-facing impact reported? Is this P1?
Dave (Support): Two customers opened Intercom tickets about 502s ~14:25. Both reported <1% of requests failing for them. No enterprise-wide P1s yet.
Alice (OnCall): Mitigation plan: 1) shift 30% traffic to inference-usw2-backup; 2) scale kvcache memory and restart kv-proxy; 3) monitor 5xx for 10m. Executing traffic shift now: `rdctl route adjust inference-gateway-usw2 --backup-weight 30`
Alice (OnCall): traffic shift applied. Starting rolling restart of kv-proxy DS (shard-by-shard).
PagerDuty: note recorded on incident INC12345 by Alice (OnCall).
Alice (OnCall): 5xx rate fell to 1.4% after shift and first kv-proxy restart (2m). Cache warmup ongoing.
Bob (SRE): Good. After restarts, please capture heap profiles and /metrics from kv-proxy so we can assess leak vs mis-config. Also run runbook step 3 (increase liveness thresholds) if restarts thrash.
Erin (Infra): Heapdump scheduled and collected for pod kv-proxy-2. Uploading to /tmp/kv-dumps/kv-proxy-2-14_26.zip. Increasing mem limit now.
Dave (Support): Logged customer updates: two tickets updated to say we're mitigating, ETA monitoring. No escalations.
Carla (Product): Thx. If this is kvcache config-related we should include a rollout plan so Dedicated customers aren't affected.
Alice (OnCall): Handing off in 30m to Frank (NightOncall). Key notes: triggered by kv-proxy OOM -> cascade 502s; temporary traffic diversion applied; kv-proxy memory increased and restart done; heapdump collected; 5xx down to 0.9% and trending downward. Please watch for reoccurrence and contact SRE if >2%. @Frank
Frank (NightOncall): ack — I'll monitor the next 2 hours and escalate if it climbs.
Bob (SRE): Assigning follow-up: SRE to analyze heapdump and decide permanent mem change or fix. I'll kick off a post-incident ticket with initial RCA template.
IncidentBot: Incident INC12345 auto-updated: status=mitigated, assigned_to=Frank (NightOncall).
Alice (OnCall): closing active mitigation steps from my side. Will add final notes to the PD incident and link the heapdump.
Dave (Support): I'll follow up with the two customers in the morning with a short incident summary.
Carla (Product): If SRE flags a config regression, we'll schedule a postmortem.
Frank (NightOncall): confirmed 5xx stable at 0.7% at handoff. Good handoff notes.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Thread closed by Alice (OnCall) at 14:52 UTC.
